positions.name: PallasineChecklistAuthority
positions.frame: What establishes the Pallasine checklist as the legitimate, current onboarding procedure?
positions.why: src-1 states the checklist as a universal, mandatory practice ('Every new hire completes...') — an authority-ranking, legitimate-power move; src-2 supplies the institutional history that grounds that authority, framing the checklist as having superseded the prior wiki page. Read together, the two expressions aren't independent facts but a single move: asserting the checklist's current legitimacy by pairing the mandate with its succession over a prior artifact. No tension between them — both plain-assertion register, same matter-of-fact baseline — but the frame is what unifies a present-tense mandate with a past-tense supersession claim into one authority-establishing read.
